correctness.rationale: The displayed parameterization has exact rank 5. Exhaustive enumeration covers all \(3^5\) elements. Nilpotency was tested both by \(M^3=0\) and independently by vanishing of trace, the quadratic characteristic coefficient, and determinant; the two predicates agree on every element and hold only at zero. This proves exactly the finite existence claim and nothing about six-dimensional spaces.

value.rationale: The parameter pair \((\mathbb F_3,n=3)\) is the smallest odd-field instance beyond the already elementary \(n=2\) range of the new finite-field conjecture. The primary source supplies only a natural dimension-\(3\) construction while the conjectural target is \(6\); an explicit dimension-\(5\) construction closes two of those three missing dimensions and leaves only the sharp final step. The exact basis and complete certificate make the lower bound reusable rather than an unsupported computational observation.
